array_size_mib.description: Array size in MiB for the benchmark (positional argument).

block_size.description: Block size in bytes for test type 2 (-b).

suppress_average.description: If true, suppresses printing the average of each test (-a).

tests.description: Tests to be run. Use 'all' for all tests, or a list of integers (0 for memcpy, 1 for dumb copy, 2 for memcpy with arbitrary block size) (-t).
